o: Season 15 follows the Payne family as everyone tries settling into a calmer chapter of life. Calvin and Miranda secretly rebuild their relationship while Ella deals with the fallout of reaching out to Laura. When Laura unexpectedly returns looking for clarity—and carrying major news—it slowly creates tension throughout the family. Meanwhile, CJ and Janine struggle balancing work and home life,…

eps.o: The Paynes settle into a quieter routine, though not everybody is being fully honest. Calvin spends more time away from the house, CJ and Janine struggle to sync their schedules, and Jasmine starts wondering if Jaxson sees their relationship the same way she does.
Curtis grows irritated when Ella keeps revisiting old situations he feels should stay buried. Malik and Lisa try proving they can handle parenting without everybody stepping in to help.
Jaxson begins spending more time around the family, making things awkward for Jasmine when people start asking questions. Calvin becomes overly defensive when Miranda’s name casually comes up.

Laura’s visit creates tension throughout the house without anyone fully understanding why. Calvin tries avoiding difficult conversations while Miranda questions how long they can realistically keep things private.
CJ and Janine attempt a much-needed night to themselves, but work and family interruptions keep getting in the way. Jasmine becomes frustrated with Jaxson’s mixed signals.
Laura begins noticing certain interactions that don’t sit right with her. Curtis pressures Ella to stop trying to “fix” things before the situation gets messier.
A misunderstanding involving Calvin quickly spreads through the house. Malik and Lisa clash over parenting advice after CJ inserts himself where he wasn’t asked.
Jasmine pushes Jaxson for clarity about where they stand. Meanwhile, Calvin realizes avoiding Laura may actually be making things worse.
The family starts picking up on tension between Calvin, Miranda, and Laura, though nobody has the full story. Ella feels guiltier as things spiral further.

A family dinner goes left after Laura asks one question that makes the room suddenly uncomfortable. CJ and Janine disagree over whether family members are becoming too involved in each other’s business again.
The truth about Calvin and Miranda finally comes out, forcing the family to reevaluate weeks of strange behavior and half-truths.
Laura struggles with feeling embarrassed after realizing how much she misunderstood. Curtis blames Ella for reopening the situation in the first place.
An attempt at a relaxing getaway becomes stressful when unresolved tension follows everyone out of the house. Jasmine and Jaxson begin questioning whether they’re moving too fast.

Laura prepares to head back home after finally accepting things have changed ,but admits she has a secret of her own that leaves Ella stunned. Calvin and Miranda stop hiding their relationship, while the Payne family tries putting months of tension behind them—even if not everything feels fully resolved yet.
Miranda becomes annoyed when Calvin starts acting unusually private with his phone after Laura leaves town. Meanwhile, CJ accidentally sparks drama at work that follows him home.

Curtis gets serious about turning his Sauce Boss idea into something bigger, pushing it beyond just the house and into a real business move. Ella supports him, but the rest of the family starts questioning whether he’s moving too fast. As Curtis doubles down on his plans, not everyone is convinced it’s the right direction.

Curtis and Ella insists on forcing the whole family together for Sunday dinner after weeks of tension. Jasmine and Jaxson disagree about spending time with each other’s families, while Malik and Lisa debate moving into their own place.
Ella struggles with accepting how independent everyone has become. Calvin and Miranda hit their first real rough patch since getting back together.
